name: Po Sah Inu towers
kicker: Three Cham towers on Ba Nai Hill
summary: Three Cham towers on Ba Nai Hill: walk the brick shrines, about 7 km from Phan Thiet. The main tower holds a Linga-Yoni altar. Admission is 7,000–15,000 VND. The English catalogue and the Binh Thuan catalogue close at 17:00. The Vietnamese catalogue closes at 18:00. The English catalogue sets no time limit. The Binh Thuan catalogue sets 120 minutes.
getThere: About 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center, on the road to the strip.

body: Walk the three brick towers on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai. Vietnam Tourism calls them 1,200-year-old Hoa Lai national monuments. The main tower holds a Linga-Yoni altar. The English catalogue describes a stone bull that once stood in the middle tower and is gone.

The hill is about 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center, on the road between the city and the Ham Tien strip. The English catalogue leaves the street line blank. The Vietnamese catalogue prints Km9 Nguyễn Thông, Phường Phú Thuỷ, Lâm Đồng. The Binh Thuan catalogue prints Phường Phú Hài, Phan Thiết, Bình Thuận.

The English catalogue sets no time limit at the towers. The Binh Thuan catalogue sets 120 minutes. Admission on all three catalogues is 7,000–15,000 VND, with no adult and child split. Katê was held here on the morning of 2 Oct 2024. An ordinary visit stays inside the posted hours.

gettingThere: The towers stand on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai, about 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center. The stop is on the road between the city and the Ham Tien strip, outside the fishing ward.
